as_told.title: 1989 Soviet UFO crash retrieval yielding a directed energy weapon

plain: Eric Davis, a scientist who worked with a Pentagon-funded study of unexplained aerial reports (he calls it the AAWSAP program), says that through it he got access to records a US intelligence agency had gathered from its own spy inside Russia, and that these records describe the Russians recovering a crashed unknown craft in the late 1980s. If true, it would mean another country, not just the US, has recovered such craft. Retelling it later, the podcast host Jesse Michels puts it in 1989, says the Soviets built a directed energy weapon (one that fires concentrated energy, like a laser) from the craft, and credits a documentary called The Age of Disclosure as his source.
